name: Basilica of the Thunder Crown
prompt_style: Objects are modeled 3D assets from a modern dark-fantasy dungeon-crawler video game (Unreal Engine 5), seen from above, sized correctly for the room, each casting a soft dark contact shadow onto the floor. Ruined basilica of a storm god: weathered grey-blue marble, tarnished bronze and green verdigris copper, faint lightning-bolt motifs, straw, earth and torn cloth from giant rabbit nests.

1.name: Narthex of the Gate
1.art: the entrance hall of a ruined basilica: two toppled bronze braziers, a cracked marble holy-water basin, scattered torn hymnals, straw nests and rabbit droppings along the walls.

2.name: Warren Nave
2.art: a side nave overrun by giant rabbits: large burrow holes dug through broken floor slabs, mounds of dug earth, chewed wooden pews knocked over, scattered small bones.

3.name: Treasury of Offerings
3.art: an offering hall: a large heavy iron-banded wooden chest in the middle with its lid closed, collapsed offering tables, shattered votive lamps, two tall bronze lightning-bolt sculptures on plinths.

4.name: Choir Passage
4.art: a narrow choir gallery: broken wooden choir stalls along both long walls, fallen hymn boards, a toppled bronze lectern.

5.name: Chapel of Columns
5.art: a small columned chapel (the round stone columns are already drawn; leave them exactly): a cracked marble altar with a bronze lightning sigil at the north end, rabbit straw nests between the columns.

6.name: Fallen Bell Hall
6.art: a hall where a huge bronze bell has fallen and cracked on the floor in the middle, a coil of thick rotten bell rope, heaps of rubble from the broken ceiling.

7.name: Wailing Vestry
7.art: a vestry: open wardrobes of rotted priest robes, a tall cracked mirror on a stand, prayer stools, a chest of moth-eaten vestments.

8.name: Stormglass Antechamber
8.art: a small antechamber: the floor inlaid with a ring of copper lightning runes, two weathered marble statues of a bearded storm god holding thunderbolts flanking the walls.

9.name: Sanctum of the Thunder Crown
9.art: the high sanctum (the round stone columns are already drawn; leave them exactly): a raised marble altar dais in the center bearing a bronze crown on a cushion, black scorch marks radiating across the floor from the altar, a huge nest of shredded blue tapestries and straw, gnawed bones.

10.name: Sacristy Rail
10.art: a narrow sacristy: a long copper rail fixed along one wall, shelves of tarnished chalices and bronze plates, a fallen candle stand.

11.name: Lamp Store
11.art: a small store room: stacks of bronze oil lamps, broken wooden shelves, a cracked oil jar with a dried stain.

12.name: Penitent's Cell
12.art: a monk's cell: a stone cot, iron chains on the wall, a kneeling stool, a small cold brazier.

13.name: Censer Chamber
13.art: a chamber with a huge bronze censer hanging on chains in the center over a cracked floor slab, scattered incense cones, a toppled candle rack.

14.name: Reliquary Store
14.art: a collapsed reliquary: toppled stone shelves, heaps of debris and broken saint statues, a cracked stone sarcophagus, scattered bone relics.

15.name: Goblin Camp
15.art: a ruined chapel used as a goblin scavenger camp: three bedrolls, a small burnt-out campfire, two dead goblins, a wounded goblin propped against the east wall with a dented iron helm beside him, chewed packs and rabbit tracks.
